name: IBM
description: IBM sells enterprise software (Red Hat, automation, data, mainframe transaction processing), technology and business consulting, and infrastructure (mainframes, servers, storage and their maintenance) to large organizations, plus a small captive financing arm that funds clients' purchases of IBM products. Software is under half of revenue but about 61% of segment profit at a 33.1% margin; consulting is 31% of revenue at an 11.7% margin. Much of the revenue recurs through subscriptions, transaction-based software and multi-year support and outsourcing contracts. It is growing by acquisition (HashiCorp 2025-02-27, Confluent 2026-03-17) and has used no buyback since 2019.

employees.note: IBM and wholly owned subsidiaries 264.3 thousand; a further 8.7 thousand in less-than-wholly-owned subsidiaries and about 13.8 thousand complementary (temporary, part-time) workforce.

businessLines.name: Software
businessLines.how: Subscriptions, licences, and per-transaction software on clients' own or cloud systems (Red Hat, automation, data, mainframe transaction processing); recurring with high gross margin (83.5%).

businessLines.name: Consulting
businessLines.how: Fees from consultants and managed-services staff billed on projects and multi-year contracts to implement technology and run business processes for clients.

businessLines.name: Infrastructure
businessLines.how: One-time sales of mainframes, Power servers and storage (cyclical with product launches) plus recurring maintenance and support contracts on the installed base.

businessLines.name: Financing
businessLines.how: Interest and lease income as a captive financier on loans and leases that let clients pay for IBM hardware, software and services over time.

brands.name: Red Hat
brands.note: Bought in 2019 (share repurchases suspended at that time); revenue within Software, not broken out in the filings read.

brands.name: Confluent, Inc.
brands.note: Acquired 2026-03-17 at $31 per share in cash, enterprise value about $11 billion; folded into Software.
